newsitem.title: USA: Berger Holdings sees '96 revenues up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Berger Holdings sees '96 revenues up 21 pct.

text.p: Berger Holdings Ltd said Wedensday it expects to report net income of about $1 million for the year ending December 31, versus a loss of $850,000 for the previous year.
The company also expects its 1996 revenues to increase 21 percent over those for 1995, said Joseph Weiderman, company president and chief operating officer.
The company had previously reported earnings of $466,000, or $0.13 per share for six months ending June 30, versus a loss of $74,000 or $0.02 per share for the comparable 1995 period.
